"Why?" asked the Racoon dog.
"Well, everybody knows, Racoon dog bites"
"Oh, no! No!" said the Racoon dog, who was anxious to cross the river. "Everybody knows that Racoon dogs are afraid of water, and we cannot swim and we will drown! Why would I do such a thing?"
The Crocodile thought for a while, and realized it was true! "He will die, if he bites me!" He thought! So he asked the Racoon dog to hop on his back. Half-way across the river, the Crocodile felt the deadly bite from the Racoon dog.
"Hey, now we're both going to drown, why did you do that?" asked the Crocodile.
"Because you a fuck boy" responded the Racoon dog, turned out he could swim the whole time.
